name: NIST AI RMF 1.0
description: NIST Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework outcomes across Govern, Map, Measure, and Manage. Short original summaries.

requirements.title: Govern AI risk
requirements.summary: Policies, accountability, and third-party AI risk oversight.

children.title: AI legal and policy governance
children.summary: Written governance policies align AI deployments with privacy and security rules.

children.title: Third-party AI supply-chain oversight
children.summary: External AI models and datasets are assessed for security and licensing risks.

requirements.title: Map AI context
requirements.summary: Intended use, boundaries, and potential failure modes are documented.

children.title: Context and boundary documentation
children.summary: Each AI feature records its purpose, scope limits, and data classification.

children.title: Risks and limitations analysis
children.summary: Hallucination, data leakage, and misuse scenarios are entered in the risk register.

requirements.title: Measure trustworthiness
requirements.summary: Evaluation of accuracy, grounded citations, security, and drift.

children.title: Model security and accuracy evaluation
children.summary: Automated tests and human reviews evaluate prompt injection, privacy, and groundedness.

requirements.title: Manage AI risks
requirements.summary: Mitigation plans, incident response, and decommissioning.

children.title: Mitigation and fallback controls
children.summary: AI features provide safe deterministic fallback and human approval gates.

children.title: Post-deployment monitoring and incidents
children.summary: AI failures and misuse events flow through the security incident register.
